CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid plugins by Alexander Schubert. UGREEN NAS Control brings LED control to UGREEN DX/DXP/iDX NAS (it succeeds UGREEN LED Control) and system info, temperatures, a case view and fan control with curves to the UGREEN DXP6800 Pro and DXP4800 GT. Support is in the Unraid forum thread and the GitHub issues of each plugin.
